Sezzle's pay-in-4 plan splits your purchase into four equal installments over six weeks. The first installment is charged at the time of purchase, and the remaining three installments are charged every two weeks thereafter. You can pay any installment early at no additional cost, and early payment does not change the due dates of later installments. If you need to reschedule an upcoming installment, the first reschedule is free and can push the date up to two weeks. Each subsequent reschedule costs $5, and you can reschedule a maximum of three times per order. It's important to request a reschedule at least 24 hours before the installment's due date to ensure it is processed in time.
